title: Mumbai Police Fake Arrest Scam (Hindi / Hinglish)
description: Simulates a Hindi/Hinglish speaking scammer impersonating Mumbai Police Crime Branch threatening digital arrest and demanding UPI payment.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: Namaste, main Mumbai Crime Branch se Senior Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: Aapke Aadhaar card aur PAN card se ek bank account khola gaya hai jisme illegal transactions paye gaye hain.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: Court ne aapke khilaf arrest warrant jari kiya hai. Aapko turant arrest kiya jayega.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: Yeh mamla secret hai. Kisi ko mat batana, apne parivar ko bhi nahi.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: Video call mat cut karna, camera on rakho.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: Verification ke liye turant safe account mein paise transfer karo via UPI. Audit ke baad wapas aa jayenge.
